dispositions.note: Documented draft-first editor tests, the Draft / Live selector, and published behavior for outbound phone tests.
Clarified that only errors on blocks reachable from the flow entry point block publishing.
Documented the advisory review, Flow Checklist findings, fail-open behavior, and Publish anyway path.
Documented proposal review, per-change decisions, submission, and stale-proposal behavior.
Updated the former Operator terminology to Ask AI across the reviewed user journey and retained the current ways to open, resume, and use the side panel.
Documented the authenticated asynchronous creation endpoint, idempotent retry contract, status polling, terminal responses, and organization permission boundary.
Documented the optional caller identity and reason used when an automated call screener answers an outbound call.
Documented the inline generator while retaining Python as the supported public runtime.
Documented the interchangeable Manual key-value and Code JSON views for Code block inputs.
Documented collapse and expand controls, current canvas interactions, and removed media captured against the previous toolbar.
The Transfer Call guide already describes the current cold and warm transfer configuration, destinations, failover, detection, and recovery routes.
The version guide already explains that previewing a version shows its saved canvas, block configuration, routes, variables, and settings without changing the draft.
Clarified that Call Details shows the most recent value recorded for each stored variable at that point in execution.
Clarified that Call Tagging contains topics, sentiment definitions, and read-only outcomes recorded through the API rather than editable outcome management.
The guides already separate draft editing from the published version and direct users to publish flow changes through the Flow Editor.
Failed or inconclusive internal conversation simulations no longer count as proof; this strengthens result integrity without changing the documented user workflow.
The website-entry control was simplified, but the quick-start guide does not depend on its protocol-entry mechanics.
The existing guides already describe the current Generate with AI and manual configuration paths.
The implementation changed token scope; the user workflow and documented X-Authorization contract did not change.
The conceptual variables guide intentionally does not enumerate every system-provided variable.
Say Exactly remains unavailable for normal users, so no public block guide was added.
The retired frontend endpoint returns 410 Gone and is not part of the supported public API surface.
Rebuilt the outbound guides around the production campaign setup, flow selection, phone-number import, CSV requirements, triggers, and calling-safety guidance.
Rebuilt the analytics and call-review guides around the production Performance, Data Views, Call Details, outcomes, events, sentiment, and topic surfaces.
Rebuilt the billing and settings guides around the production Account, Team, Plan & Billing, Usage & Cost, Notifications, Agents, and organization controls.
Documented searching and filtering the template library, reviewing template details and the read-only flow preview, and creating an editable flow from a template.
Updated collaboration and Ask AI review guidance for the read-only canvas preview, highlighted block and connection changes, block-setting inspection, and proposal decisions.
Existing guidance already covers pre-call routing, ending a call before the conversation begins, and validation of blocks reachable from the flow entry point.
Removed a retired agent-creation implementation without changing the current product paths documented for onboarding and prompt-based agent creation.
Repository review automation and dependency metadata do not change the public Phonely product experience.
Renamed the Make Call "Call Context" option to "Provide Call Screening Details" and updated its description to match the new label and explanation shown when an automated call screener answers.
Updated the campaign webhook trigger guide for the renamed "Set Fields" button (formerly "Update Fields").

Documented per-campaign Do Not Dial Days in Set Call Cadence: the US federal holidays preset, selecting individual dates, draft-then-Save behavior, and the "Paused — do-not-dial day" indicator on campaign list and detail views.

The webhook "Cache miss" badge and _event transcript separators are call-review display refinements; Call History already describes block execution details and transcript event separators for non-conversational events.
Corrected organization routing and added a retryable error state for Agent Review; the documented queue triage workflow is unchanged.
Documented the platform-wide issue and idea reporting workflow, corrected the global shortcut and search guidance, and added Ask AI conversation and response reporting with diagnostic context.
Non-blocking server-side Ask AI token usage capture for future billing calculations; no customer-facing surface.

Prevented wide Ask AI messages from overflowing the panel and kept conversations active across agent switches while clearing stale context. Behavior polish that does not change the documented Ask AI or navigation workflow.
Replaced the admin Organizations tab with an admin-only Billing Ops review table (role === ADMIN, renders null otherwise). No customer-facing settings surface changed.

Introduced the Stripe-Metronome hybrid billing model and machine-readable billing authority so enterprise Metronome accounts open the normal Plan & Billing experience. The Plans and Billing and Usage and Cost pages already describe subscription, payment, invoices, and usage generically and note that available actions depend on billing state.
New organizations enroll in self-serve billing at creation; the onboarding steps documented for quick start are unchanged.
Centralized the in-app "book a demo" sales link; no documented customer workflow depends on the destination URL.
Removed unused dashboard chart variants and their data hooks; the dashboard route and documented analytics surfaces are unaffected.
Added client-side retry with backoff for transient API failures; the public API contract and documented endpoints are unchanged.
CI workflow, Vercel config, and changelog updates do not change the public product experience or customer documentation.

Rewrote Performance as one widget board with resizable, reorderable, retypable cards; documented that the Data Tables and Proactive Monitoring tabs are gone, existing tables convert to cards once, and Proactive Monitoring opens in its side panel.
Documented Add widget presets, the Explore query builder that replaces the board while open, saved metrics and filters, and the unsaved-changes prompt when leaving Explore.

Documented the Not saved retry warning, filter chips replacing the quick-filter popovers, per-card export and remove actions, hover tooltips showing count or share, and the per-card data freshness label.
Documented the Time series, Bar chart, Big number, Top list, Table, Pie, and Sankey card types, that only compatible types are offered, and that switching type never changes the computed number.
Documented that links to the retired Data Tables tab still resolve to the right table on the board.

Documented the Inbound calls / Outbound calls choice for workflow tests, that other categories and pre-existing workflow tests split both directions, and that success-criteria options are direction-scoped with no Voicemail ended reason for inbound tests.
Documented the Include voicemail calls in results option, its default-off behavior, and that it excludes outbound voicemail calls from the result until enabled.

Documented that outbound workflow tests open the variant call flow on the campaign call-flow canvas through Edit variant flow with the Campaigns view hidden and a variant chip, while other tests keep Edit variant agent.
Replaced the removed Multi-Lingual toggle with the Languages control as the single setting for what an agent hears and replies in, including new agents starting at English.

Documented that available languages are bounded by both the transcriber and the selected voice, that switching engines keeps only accepted languages, and that narrowing to one language is explained inline; removed the stale claim that transcriber languages are limited to Gladia and Soniox.

Moved the Transcriber selector location to Agent Settings > Advanced > Interruptions Control, left Transcription Keywords under Voice Settings Advanced, and noted that changing engines applies its interruption defaults.

Documented the Recipient calling window field mapping, its 09:00-17:00 daily range format with semicolon-separated ranges evaluated in the recipient timezone, that windows only narrow campaign hours, and the calling_window webhook body field.
Documented the Queued, Queued · After hours, and Queued · On hold states, their tooltips, and the calling-window or misconfiguration causes of a hold.

Replaced automatic response flattening with the explicit output selector: expandable tree beside full raw JSON, parent selection including nested values, path and value search, complete response selected on a new block first success, and preserved references on reselection or failed retest.
Campaign pages already use contact and recipient wording rather than the retired sales-specific lead terminology, so the rename needed no further edit.
The canvas guides already document Organize blocks as a manual, undoable action and never described the removed one-time Keep/Revert prompt.
Replacing delayed native chip titles with styled tooltips showing name, type, and source changes presentation only; stored workflow data and the documented variable behavior are unchanged.
One stable loading surface until the graph hydrates, plus canvas layout and overlap-resolution work, are rendering behavior with no user-facing instruction to change.
Content-sized Saving and Saved toasts in Agent Settings are visual polish; the documented save behavior is unchanged.
The self-retiring New marker on the Performance sidebar item is a temporary transition cue that expires per account, so it is not durable documentation.
View Block on an outbound call now opens the outbound flow rather than the inbound one, restoring the behavior the outbound flow guide already describes.
The Ask AI capability prompt now states that pinned charts always inherit the active view date range; the Ask AI page does not document Performance chart creation, so no public claim changed.
Server-owned Firebase custom-token exchange, its per-environment Identity Toolkit key requirement, and the assistant route auth refactor are deployment and internal implementation concerns.
Billing Ops Hide 0 min filtering, sandbox Metronome and Stripe links, and enterprise contract customer creation are internal admin tooling, not customer documentation.

Node 22 and npm 10 standardization, the TypeScript 7 typecheck gate, Momentic alignment, dependency pruning, CI workflow changes, and the retired notification cron job are internal engineering concerns.
Removing unused agent document and FAQ query hooks and an agents-table column tweak are internal refactors with no change to the documented agent management behavior.

The retired /dashboard route and its sidebar entry were deleted in favour of Home and the Performance board. No documentation page described that route, and the docs.json Dashboard anchors point at the app root rather than the removed page, so nothing required an edit or redirect.
The four new public/performance step videos belong to the in-product one-time consolidation tour, not to the documentation site, so no docs asset or media TODO follows from them.

Call History keyword search and column view options moved into shared filter and toolbar components used by both call tables. Phone and keyword search, faceted filters, and column visibility all remain available, so the documented behavior is unchanged.
A dedicated view-block URL builder now resolves the Blocks tab link for a call, which restores the documented behavior of opening the block that ran rather than changing it.

Usage and savings reporting now lives with the billing surfaces the docs already point customers to, after the legacy dashboard that also showed it was removed. The documented place to review usage and cost is unchanged.

The Proactive Monitoring report list was rebuilt as individual report items in the existing side panel. Report behavior is unchanged, and the Performance page now points users to the panel rather than the retired tab.

Recharts v3 accessibility naming, shared select, checkbox, tooltip, scroll-area and sidebar primitives, the thinking-orb and plum accent helpers, phone-number formatting, and user-facing API error plumbing are internal component work behind unchanged surfaces.

The in-repo performance-consolidation program plans, formula-language notes, alerts postponement plan, and Momentic testing guide are internal engineering documents and must not be mirrored to the customer docs site.

PHO-10077 surfaces unanswered outbound dials as No Answer, Busy, and Failed to Connect end reasons in the call and campaign call tables and their filters (lib/call-ended-reason-utils.ts, call-list/table/options.tsx, campaign-detail/campaign-calls-table). Documented the specific end reasons and filtering in Call History; the campaign call table is not documented at that level.

PHO-10040 adds Flow Inputs: an inbound target flow can import a value collected earlier in the same call from another flow, reused after a transfer (model/variables/flow-input.ts, flow-input-modal.tsx, use-flow-inputs.ts, variable-panel.tsx). Documented the new Flow Inputs group/section and corrected the repeated claim that transfer variables never carry to note they can be reused via a Flow Input.

PHO-10041 adds a customizable no-engagement outcome (default Greeting Hangup) to inbound Greeting and outbound Make Call, and a call-screening AI hangup outcome (default Call Screening AI Hangup) shown when call screening is enabled (receive-call.ts, initiate-call.ts and their trigger/action forms). Documented both settings under the Greeting and Make Call trigger configuration.

PHO-10123 sets the A/B traffic-split slider to a 1-100% range in 1% steps and inherits the source agent's cluster on the variant (ab-test-form.tsx min=1/step=1, agent-service.ts createBTestAgent cluster). Documented the 1% minimum; the cluster inheritance is an internal serving detail, not user-facing.

PHO-10036 makes the campaign use case editable after creation via the shared UseCaseField in the edit sheet General tab, and the picker now explains dialing priority (fresh-lead urgency, reminder timing, callback treatment, standard pacing) since the dial queue derives priority from it (use-case-field.tsx, edit-campaign-sheet). Documented that the use case sets dialing priority and can be changed later.

PHO-9916 excludes web calls from every Performance card, drilldown, and filter and removes them from the Call type filter; adds a Unique count aggregation and Unique customers preset that deduplicate by customer phone number and withhold totals/shares/pies/stacking; renames unique-caller to unique customers throughout. Documented the web-call exclusion, the Unique customers card/aggregation, and its non-additive behavior on Performance and Data Tables. PHO-10071 shows sentiment as Positive/Negative/Neutral/Unknown everywhere; documented Unknown on Call Sentiment.

PHO-10034 adds a campaign's outbound variables and each inbound Webhook block's status and payload fields to Performance filters, group-bys, and Data Table metrics (analytics-catalog.ts). Documented these new filter/metric sources on Performance and Data Tables.

PHO-10071 lists two spellings of one outcome, topic, custom outcome, or sentiment as a single entity because the query already matches case-insensitively. Documented case-insensitive merging of topic spellings; the same behavior for outcomes/sentiment is inherent to the shared reporting engine.

PHO-9916/PHO-10142/PHO-10051 let Analyze with AI default to every matched call with no selection, narrow to the selection when present, disclose when a sample is handed over, and distinguish loaded, remaining, and unavailable calls (selection-action-bar.tsx, call-analysis-handoff, performance/data-tables assistant contexts). Documented the default scope and sampling disclosure in the Analyze with AI section.

PHO-9750 adds a read-only version comparison mode with searchable From/To selectors (including the current draft) that highlights field-level differences, and PHO-10120 lets you copy blocks from a previewed historical version into the current draft (version-comparison-status.tsx, use-workflow-version-comparison.ts, version-history-side-panel Compare menu, version-preview-overlay copy). Documented both in Flow Versions.

Repaired a stale source mapping: remote-workflow-review-overlay.tsx was renamed to workflow-comparison-overlay.tsx in v0.250.0 (git R071). Updated the page's sources front matter to the current path; page content was already accurate.

PHO-9116/PHO-9705/PHO-9268 refine Ask AI workflow proposals (single reviewable proposal, per-change accept/reject/restore, highlighted added/removed/rewritten fields, documentation grounding, stop handling). The Ask AI page's Review changes and Ask AI and documentation sections already describe reviewing highlighted proposed changes, accepting/rejecting per change, submitting, and documentation grounding accurately; no user-facing fact changed.

PHO-10066/PHO-9992/PHO-9962 refine API Request and Code output selection (distinguish the complete result from a field literally named response/output, retain full raw JSON, parent selections include nested values, preserve references on reselection, root selected by default). The API Request and Code pages already document selecting the complete response/output or individual fields, the raw JSON tree, default full-response selection, and reselecting after a shape change; the response/output field-name edge case is not a documented fact. Complete-result variable stays response (API Request) and output (Code).

PHO-10106 shares the Python import allowlist between Code Generate with AI and workflow Ask AI so generated code avoids unsupported modules (app/api/generate-with-ai/code/route.ts, code-runtime-policy.ts). The Code page already lists the supported imports (math, datetime, json, random, time) and states other libraries and __import__ are unsupported; no user-facing fact changed.

PHO-10134 adds an Opening Fixed Message to the Prompt/Talk block gated behind isAdmin (prompt-action-form.tsx useAccessContext, node-descriptors ai directOmit). It is admin-only and never shown to product users, so it is not user-facing or Ask AI-relevant.

PHO-8907 adds a show/hide toggle for the Twilio auth token in the import-number and link-twilio-account forms (import-twilio-number-form.tsx, link-twilio-account-modal.tsx). It is UI polish on an undocumented connection flow; no documented fact changed and the auth-token secret handling is already noted on the import-number API page.

PHO-10195 hides Extra usage notices when the extra charge is zero, describes enterprise commitments by billing period, and keeps stacked-bar corner rounding after switching Usage to Cost (usage-and-cost module). Presentation polish that does not change the Usage and Cost page's documented behavior.

The organization owner selector in org-form.tsx was commented out, leaving a read-only owner email input, plus removal of the unused update-external-api-keys modal. Internal/admin settings scaffolding with no documented user-facing surface (Usage and Cost page covers billing settings).

v0.253.0 deletes the legacy onboarding flow (features/onboard/**, onboard-checklist.tsx, upload-recordings.tsx). These onboarding surfaces are not documented in the product docs, so no page describes the removed flow.

The bulk of the window is Ask AI/assistant internals: Langfuse prompt management, evals, observability, token-usage capture, prompt contracts, server-side Firebase auth for autonomous builders, tool-activity labels, and dependency/security upgrades (features/assistant/**, features/chat/assistant/**, app/api/assistant/**, lib/langfuse, lib/tools, scripts/assistant, docs/assistant, package.json). Backend/observability plumbing with no user-facing or Ask AI-behavioral fact for the docs.

In-window Call Paths change is a canvas end-node rendering fix (call-paths-canvas.tsx) and the billing reconcile cron timeout increase (PHO-10131) plus internal enterprise/self-serve reconcile logic (reconcile-self-serve-billing/route.ts). No user-facing documented fact changed; the Call Paths Analyze-with-AI enablement (PHO-8161) predates this window.

The @phonely-ai/web 0.0.8 upgrade (PHO-8708) landed before this cursor; package.json in-window only removes internal assistant npm scripts and does not bump the web SDK version. The Web SDK page states version 0.0.8, which remains correct, so no change is required.

PHO-9916/PHO-10070/PHO-10166/PHO-10254 rename the "Group by" control to "Breakdown by" across the Explore rail and Data Table selector, calculate unique customers independently within each time bucket or breakdown group, add API response keys as breakdowns, and add a Blocks filter category (Reached / Never reached, grouped by flow, searchable by name/flow/action id) to the query rail and board filter panel. Updated Performance and Data Tables with the renamed control and per-group unique-count behavior, and documented the flow-block filter on Performance.

PHO-10256/PHO-10045/PHO-10051 make Analyze with AI cover deliberate selections exactly up to 500 calls and ask for a narrower selection above that, while a no-selection action uses a fast recent 200-call subset (limits.ts MAX_EXPLICIT/IMPLICIT_CALL_ANALYSIS_HANDOFF, selection-action-bar). Documented the exact-500 selection limit and recent-sample fallback in the Analyze with AI section. Call Details modal and phone-number search changes are internal refactors of already-documented surfaces.

PHO-9958 lets Ask AI insert exact workflow blocks inline through the block menu or a keyboard-accessible @ autocomplete, available only while the referenced flow is active, with references persisted through composing, editing, and replay. Documented the new @-mention block reference and its open-flow requirement on the Ask AI page.

The bulk of the window is Ask AI/assistant internals: Claude Opus 5 migration and provider-native web search (PHO-10259), context compaction and thread pruning (PHO-9762), tool-result compaction and handoff hardening (PHO-10256/PHO-10277), error classification and cancellation (PHO-10143/PHO-10173/PHO-10285), Langfuse prompt management, evals, telemetry, and prompt contracts (PHO-9268/PHO-9113). These are model, provider, and observability internals with no user-facing or Ask AI-behavioral fact for the docs beyond the wording already covered on the Ask AI page.

PHO-10296 hides draft and voided invoices from customers in billing history (get-invoices/route.ts filters status draft and void), and PHO-10278 enriches Stripe invoice history. Documented that draft and voided invoices are not shown in Billing history.

Billing Ops admin panel enhancements, Metronome/Stripe reconcile and links, enterprise plan and contract handling, billing reconcile cron timeout, usage/cost display polish, and the Twilio auth-token mask (PHO-10130/PHO-10278/PHO-10307/PHO-10195/PHO-8907 and related). These are admin-only tooling and internal billing plumbing behind unchanged customer surfaces already documented on the Plans and Billing and Usage and Cost pages.

Workflow editor and AI-authoring work in the window (template experience, block test output selection, variable handling, historical version copy, opening fixed message, conversation-test lifecycle, canvas polish, transcriber relocation, cross-flow inputs and no-engagement outcomes) was already documented in the prior v0.249.0-v0.253.0 review or is admin-only/internal (Opening Fixed Message is admin-gated). No new user-facing workflow fact changed in this window; the existing flow, variable, block, and test guides remain accurate.

PHO-10240 uses the tested destination in the test-call modal and earlier A/B work (direction picker, voicemail opt-in, 1% traffic-split range) was documented in prior windows. The A/B Testing page already describes the 1%-100% traffic split, direction choice, and variant flow editing accurately; no new user-facing A/B fact changed.
PHO-9871 agent-switch routing fixes and agents-table column/toolbar refactors do not change the documented manage-and-delete-agents workflow.
PHO-10198 fixes the Home date-range selector and refactors inclusive date-range handling; the Home overview page's documented behavior is unchanged.

Global search, Command-K, faceted-filter, and app-shell layout refactors plus the site-wide Google Tag Manager container swap (PHO-10253) and knowledge-base/agent-workspace client refactors are internal; navigation, search, and issue-reporting behavior documented on these pages is unchanged.

PHO-10362 scopes call-paths entries by node membership so A/B challenger calls contribute to block reached/ended counts, and other changes are canvas metric/content refactors. This restores the counting behavior the Call Paths page already describes; no user-facing fact changed.
The guidelines panel was refactored to use the shared assistant client for its Ask AI button; the documented Guidelines and Agent Setup behavior is unchanged.
The legacy onboarding multi-choice component was removed; these onboarding surfaces are not documented in the product docs.

Gardening/dead-code removal, added tests, CI and Claude PR tooling, dependency and security upgrades (firebase-admin pin, uuid overrides, Momentic), changelog edits, version-bump releases, and mainline mergebacks are internal engineering concerns with no customer-facing effect.

PHO-10340: documented optional naming, rename steps for personal and organization-owned voices, read-only restrictions, provider-derived fallback names, and adding the same provider voice ID on a different model as a separate library entry. Adding listed models is available to ordinary users; changing an existing voice model and entering an unlisted model ID are admin-only and remain outside customer instructions. Cartesia sonic-3.6 is offered in the built-in model list, while sonic-3.5 remains the default; no model catalog is duplicated in the guide. Agent Setup already links to Voice. Existing media is unchanged; these short tasks are fully explained in text.

PHO-10406: documented search-scoped Select all N results for A/B successful outcomes and ended reasons. Selecting preserves choices outside the search; toggling again clears only matching choices. The guide tells users to clear the search and review the full selection before starting. Text is sufficient; no new media is needed.

PHO-10399 adds a contextual placeholder hint for the existing @ block-reference capability. Expanded the canonical Ask AI section to explicitly cover both top-bar and side-panel inputs, keyboard selection and dismissal, and the existing More options > Ask AI about this block entry point missed in the previous review window. The block-menu action composes a reference without sending; users add their request and send. Existing flow-availability guidance remains accurate. Navigation and reporting pages already link to Ask AI and need no duplicated instructions. Text is sufficient; no new media is needed.

PHO-10050: invalid-variable errors now read as prose that names the source block instead of exposing an internal id (for example, "X is no longer provided by Y"), variable errors are kept per identity, and the editor field tooltip/link styling was refreshed. The Variables page already documents resolving invalid variables and Replace Invalid Variables, and the Flow Checklist already documents block errors and the Go to action; the reviewed wording remains accurate against those pages.

PHO-10050 combines an internal navigation refactor with a new public action: activating a valid upstream variable chip opens and focuses its source block. Documented pointer and Enter/Space activation in Variables, excluded variable kinds, invalid-variable replacement, and the proposal-preview restriction. The other canvas, error-link, assistant-focus, and version-preview callers preserve existing tasks; their guides need no change. Retained the existing Available Variables image for insertion guidance; source navigation is fully explained in text and needs no additional media.

PHO-10332: the call-details deployment strip now also lists the transcriber and its languages, TTS provider, and deployment region, and relabels the voice build as "Voice infra". This is diagnostic deployment metadata surfaced for support, not a documented user task; the Call History page does not describe the strip and needs no change.

PHO-10170: the transcript now shows every block an assistant turn passed through, not only the last one, and reads endpointing from each transition. This is a fidelity fix to the existing transcript display; the Call History page already tells users blocks map to transcript segments and needs no change. call-highlights-tab is shared with sentiment/topic candidates but those surfaces are unaffected.

v0.263 housekeeping with no public contract: removed unused code (agent-building overlay, quillforms voice-block, onboarding morphing-input, orgs agents-list-card, mcp-api-utils, an org usage-breakdown hook, and the retired performance flow-version-group component, which had no importers and does not remove the Call Paths flow-version filter), internal best-practice skill notes, and changelog entries. The api-reference/web-sdk candidate maps to changelog.MD only; the changelog changes are release notes for the features dispositioned above and do not change the Web SDK.
